spans.s: = पिच्छल, slimy, slippery, ChUp. viii, 14; Śaṃk.
clung or pressed closely together, attached or devoted to, merged in (loc. or comp.), R.; Sarvad.
lying or resting on, staying in, lurking, hiding, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
dissolved, absorbed in (loc. or comp.), disappeared, vanished, ŚvetUp.; MBh. &c.
the clinging to, being dissolved or absorbed in, disappearance, Pañcar.
लीन—त्व n. (ifc.) sticking or concealment in Suśr.
having bees adhering (to anything), embraced or clung to by bees, MW.
Nom. P. ˚यति, to dissolve, melt (trans.), Pāṇ. vii, 3, 39, Sch.
